items.title: Ruth Brisbane interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 2, 2013
items.q: And he loves crazy people like Ornette Coleman.

ctx.x: And he loves crazy people like Ornette Coleman. Some of the CDs he has, please, I don’t want to hear that again. © Fillius Jazz Archive -12-

Yeah, I have some of those memories. The first Coltrane album I bought I was unaware of what he was doing, and it was called “Om.” And it was very, very progressive. My ears were not ready for it yet.
